dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans in the Northern Part of the Halmahera Group
dct_alternative_sm: Plans in the Northern Part of the Halmahera Group
dct_description_sm: From Netherland Government Surveys between 1914 and 1924; Published Mar., 1938, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Relief shown by form lines, spot heights; depths by soundings, tints.
Includes Conversion Table, Tidal Information, Malayan and English Terms table.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, buildings.

Chart 1. North Loloda Islands -- Chart 2. Djailolo Road -- Chart 3. Sangowo Anchorage -- Chart 4. Tifonis and Doro Lemo Anchorages -- Chart 5. Weda Road -- Chart 6. Galela Road -- Chart 7. South Loloda Islands -- Chart 8. Soepoe Bay -- Chart 9. Diti Anchorage -- Chart 10. Tobelo Road -- Chart 11. Rao Strait and Wajaboela Road -- Chart 12. Boeli Bay.
